programme.title: Timewatch
programme.desc: An investigation into the Gunpowder Plot of 1605. The programme focuses on how a group of Catholic Englishmen became so radicalised and intent on mass murder they attempted to destroy the Houses of Parliament. State-of-the-art CGI shows the building as it would have looked, and the extent of the damage if the explosion had taken place

programme.title: Secrets of Skin
programme.desc: Professor Ben Garrod explores how animals' skin acts as a barrier between them and the outside world, shielding them from extremes of temperature, harmful effects of UV and organisms

programme.title: Gareth Edwards' Great Welsh Adventure
programme.desc: In the Brecon Beacons, Gareth and wife Maureen inspect their accommodation - a shepherd's hut complete with lush rolling hills for a view and sheep for neighbours. Out and about, they receive a lesson in controlling a full-sized tank, with Maureen keen to see how the vehicle can pick up speed. After getting some tips from champion clay pigeon shooter Rhys Lewis, photographer Rhian Mai meets the pair at a spectacular natural cave to help hone their skills in capturing the scene. The weekend ends where the original adventure began - on one of Wales' most beautiful canals

programme.title: The Planets
programme.desc: Professor Brian Cox examines Jupiter, the largest and oldest planet in the solar system, revealing how its immense gravity influenced where other planets developed, destroying several nascent planets and negatively influencing the development of Mars. Today, Jupiter's great mass continues to be felt. Its gravity torments its moon Io, creating the most volcanically active body in the solar system. And through the vice-like grip it exerts over the asteroid belt, Jupiter's influence extends as far as Earth

programme.title: Battlefield Britain
programme.desc: The Snows use state-of-the-art graphics to re-create the Battle of Britain, one of the pivotal conflicts of the Second World War. Peter explains the role of radar in detecting Luftwaffe planes as they headed for Dover, while Dan experiences the physiological effects of the high G-forces that would have been felt by the RAF pilots

programme.title: The Guns of Navarone (1961)
programme.desc: An elite group of Allied soldiers is dispatched to sabotage vital German artillery emplacements, despite the seemingly insurmountable odds and the suspicion there is a traitor in their midst. Oscar-winning Second World War adventure, based on Alistair MacLean's novel, starring Gregory Peck, David Niven, Anthony Quinn, Stanley Baker, Anthony Quayle and Irene Papas

programme.title: Halloween (1978)
programme.desc: Homicidal madman Michael Myers escapes from a mental institution 15 years after murdering his sister, and goes on a killing spree in his home town. Although a psychiatrist is quickly on his trail in a bid to stop the loss of more lives, a shy teenage girl babysitting for her neighbour is unaware of the grisly fate in store for her. John Carpenter's horror, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Donald Pleasence, Nick Castle and PJ Soles

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: A look at stories surrounding the ghost of 17th-century Edinburgh executioner George Mackenzie that sprung up in 1998 after a homeless man broke into his tomb and fell into an assembly of decomposing corpses. Within weeks, stories of blackouts and inexplicable attacks began to spread, with Edinburgh City Council locking the gates and declaring the area out of bounds for public safety. Jan Andrew Henderson began to chronicle the Mackenzie Poltergeist - only to claim to become a target of its malice

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: A look at a 1958 case in which two women travelled together to a nightclub near Lake Lanier in the US state Georgia, but never returned. Weeks later, reports began of a ghostly figure of woman in a blue dress walking across the lake, while calls for help were heard from the water below, before stories of unexplained drownings emerged. Mysterious deaths at Lake Lanier abound, whilst survivors report the feeling of being pulled into the depths or held beneath by unseen hands.

programme.title: Inside Classical
programme.desc: Owain Wyn Evans presents a concert from the BBC National Orchestra of Wales, including spooky film favourites including John Williams' Harry Potter and Jaws. Plus, Bach's gothic masterpiece Toccata and Fugue in D minor, Saint-Saëns' Danse Macabre and Rimsky-Korsakov's arrangement of Mussorgsky's Night on the Bare Mountain

In this documentary, Ian Schrager, one of the two people behind Studio 54's creation, tells the in-depth story of how one of the world's greatest nightclubs was created

programme.title: Disco: Soundtrack of a Revolution

The programme also traces the genre's legacy, with DJ Frankie Knuckles leaving New York for Chicago, where he remixed disco breaks with R&B to produce a new genre of dance music that became known as house

programme.title: True North
programme.desc: In Derry-Londonderry, a once divided city comes together for an annual celebration like no other, to share a fascination with ghosts, ghouls and the stuff of nightmares. In 1985, at the height of The Troubles, a Halloween-themed fancy-dress party in a local pub did something remarkable - it united a divided community. Forty years later, the small party that started as a fun distraction has grown into Europe's largest Halloween festival, leaving the entire city spellbound. This programme follows the ordinary people behind the extraordinary spectacle as they create and build the street theatre, costumes and art that bring Derry Halloween to life

programme.title: Stacey Dooley
programme.desc: As a new mother, Stacey's worries for the future - and about death - have only exacerbated. In order to try to overcome her fears, she wants to face death head on, so joins the team of funeral directors at Nottinghamshire-based firm, AW Lymn, one of the largest independent funeral enterprises in the country. Stacey fully immerses herself in every aspect of the company's day-to-day work to discover more about the business of death - from arranging funerals to making coffins, learning more about embalming to carving elaborate headstones - and tries to get the answers she has been searching for

programme.title: Stacey Dooley
programme.desc: In Britain shoplifting is at an all-time high, incidents of violence and abuse against shop staff have skyrocketed, and a third of Brits have admitted to stealing through the self-checkouts. To understand this apparent high-street epidemic, Stacey heads to Manchester to meet the people behind the crime and spends time on the shop floor with the staff trying to prevent further thefts

programme.title: Stacey Dooley
programme.desc: Invited into the traditionally private gypsy community, Stacey discovers the complex balancing act young women face growing up in one of Britain's most maligned ethnic minorities. In Bedfordshire she meets 23-year-old Chantelle, who prides herself in keeping with the 'old' gypsy values her grandmother taught her and shares them on social media, where she has nearly 400,000 TikTok followers. In Lincolnshire, the reporter meets 18-year-old Serena, who is planning her wedding to her fiancé Marco. He is also from a gypsy and traveller community and Serena wouldn't have it any other way

programme.title: Cunk on Earth

Now that the British are in danger from the rebellion, Javed seizes the opportunity to get Ruth and her mother, Miriam, and grandmother under his roof, with the intention of making the object of his obsession his wife. Forgetting the fact that Javed already has a wife, is this really a good basis for a marriage? And will the political forces that swirl around them allow his plan to come to fruition?

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil tries to share his love of dancing with unenthusiastic son Luke and Claire struggles to hide her frustration while teaching an overly cautious Alex to drive. Mitch and Cam enter the cut-throat world of wedding venue booking

programme.desc: Gloria settles a score with another mum during a school visit, Mitch sets out to prove he is more environmentally aware than his neighbour, Manny and Luke have a double date with twins, and Alex goes to see a therapist. Jesse Eisenberg and Jane Krakowski guest star

programme.desc: Jay is troubled when best pal Shorty reveals that he and his wife are moving away. Chazz Palminteri and Jennifer Tilly guest star

programme.desc: Claire thinks Luke is up to no good with his friends, so she persuades a reluctant Phil into helping her spy on their son. Gloria is suspicious of Jay when he starts moaning amorously in his sleep and Mitch struggles to keep a secret from Cam

programme.sub-title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer reminisces about how he gave up his dreams of being a musician so that Marge could go to Springfield University. After she became attracted to one of her professors, Homer started channelling his emotions into music and formed America's first grunge band, Sadgasm

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer, Marge and Bart get stranded in a Tunnel of Love ride at a carnival, and pass the time by telling stories about some of history's most famous couples, including Bonnie and Clyde, and Sid Vicious and Nancy Spungen

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Sideshow Bob is released from prison and goes to work for his brother Cecil on a dam-building project. Bart is highly dubious that his arch-enemy is really a reformed man and enlists Lisa's help to expose him. With the guest voices of Frasier stars Kelsey Grammer and David Hyde Pierce

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Peralta and Santiago go undercover as an engaged couple in a bid to catch an identity thief, and find that the investigation brings them closer together. Meanwhile, Boyle organises a surprise birthday party for Rosa. Comedy, with Andy Samberg and Melissa Fumero

programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: Maître D' Fred Sirieix and his team fling open the doors of the restaurant of romance once more, and first in is self-confessed party animal Nikita - a 24-year-old from Swansea who's hunting for someone just as wild. Horror, starring Allison Williams, Violet McGraw and Ronny Chieng

programme.title: Dating Naked
programme.desc: New-age hippie Ashley, and self-proclaimed sexual healer Alika, have decided to face the naked truth - they're in love and they want to get married

programme.title: First Dates

programme.desc: Scientists discover the Earth is about to be destroyed in a cosmic disaster and race against time to construct a rocket that will transport them to a new planet. Sci-fi epic which won an Oscar for its special effects, starring Richard Derr, Barbara Rush and Larry Keating

programme.title: Triple Cross (1966)
programme.desc: Fact-based Second World War spy adventure about Eddie Chapman, a bank robber who became a British double agent in exchange for money and a full pardon. Following the German invasion of Jersey, Chapman offers to provide information to the Nazis, who are unaware his loyalties really lie with the British Secret Service. With Christopher Plummer, Trevor Howard, Yul Brynner, Romy Schneider and Claudine Auger

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: Kirk becomes embroiled in an alien race's plot to reduce the population of its planet by infecting people with a lethal plague. Sci-fi adventure, starring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy

programme.title: The Dukes of Hazzard
programme.desc: Boss' dream finally comes true when he forecloses on the Duke farm, but just as he is celebrating his success, he gets a shocking call from his doctor

programme.title: Babylon 5
programme.sub-title: And All My Dreams, Torn Asunder
programme.desc: Sheridan reveals the Centauris' part in the mysterious attacks on Alliance ships, leading to trouble for Londo and bodyguard G'Kar on their return home to Centauri Prime. Meanwhile, Garibaldi agrees to take on a vital investigation

programme.title: Walker, Texas Ranger
programme.desc: The lawman steps in to help a champion kickboxer who has been framed for the murder of his manager

programme.title: The Patriot (2000)
programme.desc: Retired soldier Benjamin Martin, who turned his back on the military to become a farmer in South Carolina, takes up arms once more to avenge the unprovoked murder of his son at the hands of the British during the American War of Independence. As he seeks vengeance, he finds himself up against a sadistic officer wreaking havoc in the surrounding area. Roland Emmerich's action adventure, starring Mel Gibson, Jason Isaacs, Heath Ledger and Joely Richardson.

programme.title: Copycat (1995)
programme.desc: A gifted psychologist who is an authority on serial killers is left traumatised by an attempt on her life and becomes agoraphobic. Unable to leave her apartment, she nevertheless aids the police in the pursuit of a publicity-seeking mass murderer re-enacting famous killings. Thriller, with Sigourney Weaver, Holly Hunter, Harry Connick Jr, Dermot Mulroney, William McNamara and Will Patton

programme.title: Last Knights (2015)
programme.desc: A warrior is left a broken man when the nobleman he serves is put to death for refusing to pay tribute to a corrupt warlord. He seeks to redeem himself by reuniting his dead master's other soldiers and leading them into battle to avenge his death. Medieval action adventure, starring Clive Owen and Morgan Freeman

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: Richard is rushed to Queen's in Nottingham after collapsing suddenly at home. Doctors suspect that the 35-year-old may be going into organ failure and as they work to save his life, his mother Janette explains how the tragic loss of his cousin as a teenager affected Richard's mental health. Advanced clinical practitioner Marijke reflects on her journey to becoming a medic in the UK from the Netherlands and how Brexit made her question her identity

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: It is the turn of Charlotte Church's parents James and Maria to play host at Dexby Townhouse in Cardiff, and they pull out all the stops by laying on a day of white-water rafting and a magic performance courtesy of their nephew Elliot. But the following morning, some of the guests are kept waiting for breakfast

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: This week, the competition comes from Leamington Spa, where the first host, recruitment manager Debs, kick-starts the contest with a glam and boujee bash for her guests, who are hair and make-up student Charlie, recruitment director Barry, recruitment administrator Nikki and publican Sis

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Second to host in Leamington Spa is hair and make-up student Charlie, who is aiming to spice up the night with a 90s girl band dress code, even if his own outfit might be too small

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Third to host in Leamington Spa is recruitment director Barry, who is hoping to elevate pub classics to new heights as he takes his guests on a retro-inspired night down the pub

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: The penultimate host in Leamington Spa, Warwickshire, is publican Sis, who dons her hosting hat with a sports-inspired evening in a bid to wow her guests with some home-cooked favourites. Nikki gets the evening off to a rapturous start and regales her guests with green-fingered fables, but Debs is less than impressed by a lack of limelight. Relations are strained as the conversation switches to matters of cosmetic surgery, but the mood is lifted with a kickabout in the garden - with a surprising star player saving the day

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: The final host in Leamington Spa is lively administrative assistant Nikki, who's hoping that her musically themed menu will see her singing her way to the £1,000 prize. However, she puts her foot in it right from the start with publican Sis - likening her to a sloth. With tensions already running high with Debs, things take a turn for the awkward over mains when Nikki lets her real feelings out and things get heated around the table. Nikki cannot quite get her crowd going with her entertainment as she performs Man I Feel Like a Woman - even if it does get fellow ally Barry in the dancing mood

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: Wild West: America's Great Frontier
programme.desc: A journey along America's West coast. The programme examines how the landscape is shaped by the Pacific Ocean as well as powerful forces beneath ground, particularly along the San Andreas Fault. The programme also visits the warm and sheltered waters of the Sea of Cortez, where animals including blue whales gather, and discovers how a small community in America's westernmost point have a unique relationship with grey whales

programme.title: Attenborough's Wonder of Song
programme.desc: David Attenborough examines seven recordings of animals singing, all documented in his lifetime - including one he recorded himself. The songs are from species as varied as lyrebirds, lemurs and humpback whales, all providing an insight into the way these creatures communicate. The programme also examines new evidence on the purpose of singing, which challenges the long-held belief that it is a mating ritual - it has been theorised that both male and female songbirds sing as part of a survival strategy

programme.desc: Steered by his 1913 Bradshaw railway guide, Michael Portillo takes the train down the spine of Italy as he travels from Rome to Sicily. programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo uses his 1913 copy of Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide to explore Poland. He begins in the capital Warsaw, where he takes to the floor to dance to one of Chopin's polonaises with high-school students rehearsing for their leavers' ball, before discovering how the former industrial city of Lodz supplied the vast Russian empire of the early 20th century. He then heads to Poznan and rides one of the few remaining steam-powered commuter trains, visits a factory in Wroclaw that manufactures car bodies for locomotives, and ends his journey in Krakow, where he takes a tour in an iconic vehicle of the communist era

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo uses his 1913 copy of Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide as he travels through Spain and Portugal. He begins in the city of La Coruna, where he examines the Celtic roots of the Galician people and tries to master the bagpipes, before meeting walkers from all over the world on the pilgrims' trail to Santiago de Compostela. Heading across the border to Porto, Michael finds out about the origins of Britain's long alliance with the Portuguese, and finishes his journey in the capital Lisbon
